headline: Valmet Shares Surge 6.8% on Strong Third-Quarter Financial Results
summary: Shares of Finnish industrial equipment supplier Valmet rose 6.8% after the company delivered third-quarter financial results that exceeded market expectations.
why: Valmet is a leading developer and supplier of process technologies, automation, and services for the pulp, paper, and energy sectors globally.

impacts.name: Valmet Oyj
impacts.why: Better-than-expected third-quarter financial performance lifted equity by 6.8%.

why_moved: Valmet's stock climbed 6.8% in response to the company's strong third-quarter earnings report.
